Clockwork_Prehensile_Cable.description: This intricate, serpentine cable is a marvel of clockwork engineering, its gears and cogs shifting with fluid precision to mimic the dexterity of a living tail, granting its construct host an additional point of reach and unparalleled agility in both terrestrial and vertical navigation.

Heavy_Iron_Wrecking_Ball_Tail.description: Enveloped in dark, rusting iron plates, the Heavy Iron Wrecking Ball Tail is a fearsome appendage that swings with the destructive force of a battering ram, enhancing its wielder’s strength while hindering their agility, making each step a deliberate, crushing advance.

Steam_Venting_Propulsion_Tail.description: This mechanical tail, a marvel of dark engineering, vents scalding steam to propel its construct host at incredible speeds through both land and water, its presence marked by a halo of oppressive heat and billowing vapor, though its ominous aura diminishes the host's charisma.

Crystal_Resonance_Focusing_Tail.description: The Crystal Resonance Focusing Tail is a slender, translucent appendage that pulses with arcane light, enhancing its bearer's wisdom and charisma as it channels protective magic and amplifies their understanding of mystical energies.

Stitched_Flesh_Serpent_Tail.description: The Stitched Flesh Serpent Tail is a writhing, undead-like appendage crafted from twisted, reanimated flesh, its sinuous movements allowing for both agile terrestrial navigation and swift aquatic traversal, though its unsettling presence and aura of dread come at the cost of charisma.

Living_Wood_Thorny_Whip.description: The Living Wood Thorny Whip is a sinuous, plant-like construct that thrashes with an eerie vitality, its bark-hard thorns capable of slicing through flesh and inflicting grievous wounds, while its wooden appendage grants its wielder the strength and agility needed to ensnare and maim foes with brutal efficiency.

Gargoyle_Stone_Club_Tail.description: This gargoyle's massive stone tail, a blend of organic and inorganic materials, serves as both a powerful weapon and a formidable defensive tool, enhancing its strength and natural armor while granting it the ability to knock down foes and block attacks with devastating precision.

Mithril_Bladed_Assassin_Tail.description: This mechanical marvel is a fearsome sight to behold, with a sleek mithril tail that grants unparalleled agility and dexterity, enabling its wielder to perform death-defying acrobatics while inflicting grievous wounds with razor-sharp precision.

Scrap_Metal_Dragging_Chain.description: Beneath the dim glow of the ancient forge, a twisted construct emerges, its body a tangle of scrap metal and jagged chains, dragging a rusted chain that trails behind like a mournful tail, extending its reach while hampering its agility in the narrow confines of the dungeon.

Porcelain_Doll_Ribbon_Tail.description: This delicate porcelain ribbon tail, crafted with meticulous precision, trails behind the doll-like entity, its graceful movements enhancing the creature's charm and agility, while also granting an ethereal allure that can captivate and entice those around it.
